forms.name: FTC Online Complaint Form
forms.notes: Filed entirely online via ReportFraud.ftc.gov. No paper forms needed.

attachments_order: Copy of cancellation email(s) sent to company
Billing statements showing continued charges after cancellation

steps: Select 'Something Else' or the category that best matches your complaint
Describe the company, the subscription, and the cancellation barriers
Include dates: when you subscribed, when you attempted to cancel, when charges continued
Attach supporting documents (emails, billing statements, screenshots)
Submit the complaint — you will receive a confirmation number

notes: The FTC does not resolve individual complaints but uses them to build enforcement actions and identify patterns. Filing creates an official record. The FTC may take action against companies with a pattern of complaints. After the 8th Circuit vacated the Click-to-Cancel rule (July 2025), ROSCA and FTC Act §5 remain the enforcement basis.
